purpose: 카오틱 에센스 제거 후보의 실제 게임 효과 조사. 분류 제안만 제공하며 사용자 결정을 대신하지 않음.
readOnlyScope: 실제 jack.qsp를 core.cjs parse/shift로 읽음. 게임·세이브·번역·엔진·브라우저 조작 없음. 이 새 조사 기록만 작성.
referenceConvention: location:line, 해당 로케이션 body 기준 1-based line
classificationStatus: 사용자 승인 대기; 제거 정책 변경 없음
method: 현재 QSP 전체에서 metabolism/courage/selfesteem 사용처를 확인하고 관련 계산의 연결 효과를 조사함. 동적 실행 검증은 하지 않음.

rows.label: 미약한 대사량
benefits: 같은 잉여열량에서 지방이 가장 쉽게 늘어, 마른 체형의 회복이나 의도적으로 살찌우는 목적에 유리하다.
조수의 기본 자동식단이 대사량에 비례하므로 기본 급식비가 낮다.
drawbacks: 같은 식사에서 살이 쉽게 쪄 유지·감량 관리가 더 까다롭다.
열량으로 얻는 자연 지구력 성장량이 낮고, 감량이 시작되는 열량적자 조건이 더 엄격하다.

evidence.excerpt:
! once we know the final end-of-day calorie count: apply effects accordingly
		if dynslave['calories'] < 0:
			if dynslave['calories'] < -5 + dynslave['metabolism']:
				! weight loss if calories are at or below -5 + metabolism level [metabolism ranges from [1,5] with 1 being weakest (lose fat slowest)]
				dynslave_rate['fat'] -= rand(3, 2 + (1+dynslave['metabolism'])/2) &! weak metabolism (1) loses 3 physique points per night, powerful metabolism (5) loses 3-5 physique points per night
				! rational motivation to obey increases when a slave notices that she is losing weight (this supports the help text for the "restricted" diet portion) - ImperatorAugustus
				dynslave_rate['rational'] += 1
			end
			if dynslave['calories'] >= -5:
				! below -5 calories = starvation
				! minimal endurance loss without starvation occurs when calories are between -1 and -5, representing loss of muscle mass due to caloric deficit, offsetting exercise during the day (if any)
				if dynslave['stamina'] > 1 or dynslave['fat'] = 0: dynslave_rate['stamina'] -= 1 &! will not lower endurance below Feeble unless slave is Bony (no reserves to offset caloric deficit) - ImperatorAugustus
			end
			! a slave with no fat reserves will pass out immediately if not given enough food (-22 + fat*2 [here zero] represents full caloric deficit); removed extra stamina impact in favor of starvation effects - ImperatorAugustus
! JO9 MOD START MAID_LEFT_ACTUAL_RATION_COLLAPSE | 2026-10-19_maid_trainee_priority
			if cheat_no_starve = 0 and dynslave['fat'] = 0 and dynslave_rate['fat'] < 0 and (iif('dynslave' = 'room1', room1_ration + 1, iif('dynslave' = 'room2', room2_ration + 1, iif('dynslave' = 'room3', room3_ration + 1, iif('dynslave' = 'room4', room4_ration + 1, dynslave['diet_portion'])))) = 0 or dynslave['calories'] <= -22): dynslave_state = CONST_INT['slave_faint']
! JO9 MOD END MAID_LEFT_ACTUAL_RATION_COLLAPSE
			! a slave with no fat reserves who is not being fully deprived of food can remain at that physique indefinitely, but will have a neg_hungry moodlet applied by $next_day_starvation_effects
		elseif dynslave['calories'] > 0:
			! metabolized calories raise endurance until B+ (benefit with higher metabolism = easier to maintain weight)
! JO9 MOD START CONST_FOOD_GROWTH | 2026-10-24_constitution_unification
			if dynslave['stamina'] < 3: dynslave_rate['stamina'] += func('jo9_traits_combat', 'natural_stamina_xp', 'dynslave', min(dynslave['calories'], dynslave['metabolism']))
! JO9 MOD END CONST_FOOD_GROWTH
			! excess calories not consumed by metabolism go to fat (increase physique)
			dynslave_rate['fat'] += max(0, dynslave['calories'] - dynslave['metabolism']) &! metabolism ranges from [1,5] with 1 being weakest (gain fat easiest)
			! with max physique, excess calories can drain stamina potentially all the way to death - ImperatorAugustus
			if dynslave['fat'] = 5: dynslave_rate['stamina'] -= max(0, dynslave['calories'] - dynslave['metabolism'])

if assistant_state > CONST_INT['no_slave']:
	! assistant has already been processed by $next_day_resolve_previous_day_calorie_effects but we still need to apply $next_day_starvation_effects for the day now ending
	dynamic $replace($next_day_starvation_effects, 'dyn'+'slave', 'assistant'), 1

	! set excess calories (and costs) for next day
	assistant['calories'] = assistant['metabolism'] &! even if assistant is never given any direct instructions (only following her assigned rules), she will not gain weight
	if assistant['neg_hungry'] > 0 or (assistant['fat'] < 2 and assistant_rate['fat'] < 0): assistant['calories'] += assistant['stamina']*3 &! hungry or model-losing-weight eats more (neg_hungry implies F- physique or days_without_food > 0 or losing weight)
	if assistant['fiend_tattoo'] = 1 and spawn_semen > assistant['calories']:
		spawn_semen -= assistant['calories'] &! if fiend tattoo and enough supply, use it instead of fresh food - ImperatorAugustus
		assistant['perversion_xp'] += 1
	else
		total_food_cost += assistant['calories']/2 &! .5$/cal, equivalent to fresh food, cost varies depending on metabolism (2-4 sparks) - ImperatorAugustus

else
		pig['calories'] = 21 - iif(pig_state = CONST_INT['slave_faint'], 0, pig['ego']) &! non-fainted pig nature attribute resists (slows) weight gain, reducing profitability - ImperatorAugustus
		! Powerful Metabolism and Willful slaves resist the most (subtracting 10 calories from weight gain); pregnancy, lactation or egglaying also oppose, equivalent to one level of metabolism or nature
		if pig['neg_hungry'] > 0: pig['calories'] += pig['stamina']*3 &! hungry pigs eat more (neg_hungry implies F- physique or days_without_food > 0 or losing weight)
		barn_pig_food += 1 &! .05 - .07$/cal, rounded up to 1 spark daily, accumulating sum for decade billing (before leftovers are added to calories) - ImperatorAugustus
		if farmhand_state = CONST_INT['slave_exist'] and slave['diet_leftovers'] = 0 and cooked_food >= 0: pig['calories'] += 2 &! if slave does not eat them, farmhand feeds pig kitchen scraps, 0$ and maybe table scraps

조수 자동식단의 기본 급식비가 평균보다 높다.

rows.label: 겁쟁이
benefits: 공포 수치만큼 추가 복종 보너스를 받아 공포를 통한 훈련이 쉽다.
처벌 계산에서 겁쟁이 분기는 항상 공포 증가형 성공으로 처리되어 처벌을 통한 공포·복종 유도가 쉽다.
drawbacks: 공포 상태 판정의 저항값이 낮아져 쉽게 겁먹는다.

!Psychological status of slave
		! reluctant, arrogant, hateful, resistant, lachrymose, soft, servile, frightened, obedient, broken, depresive, horny, hysteric, optimistic, docile
		slave_psy_hardness = max(dynslave['ego'], dynslave['temper'], dynslave['spoil'], dynslave['pride'])
		slave_psy_hardness += dynslave['courage']
		courage = slave_psy_hardness
		if dynslave['mood'] > 0: courage += dynslave['mood']
		if dynslave['courage'] = 2:
			courage = 100
			dynslave['fear'] = 0 &! moronic slaves are impossible to frighten
		end

!Calculate slave obedience - crushboss
		dynamic $replace($set_obedience_difficulty, 'dyn'+'slave', 'dynslave')
